UnitStatement: The docs/ package is a seed governance and decomposition set for agentic development of OpenPipeStress.
OpenPipeStress is a source-available, noncommercial, code-neutral piping flexibility and stress-analysis platform.
The central project stance is: Open the mechanics; protect the standards; empower the engineer.
This package is written from the perspective of SOFTWARE_DECOMP, converting product intent and PRD into a structured, flat package/deliverable decomposition suitable for downstream agent execution.
../INIT.md is the Bootstrap document defining required reading order and agent startup constraints; it is maintained only at the repository root.
../AGENTS.md is the Agent index covering project-specific use of Chirality agent roles.
INTENT.md captures Directional intent: why this product exists and what must remain true.
PRD.md is the Product requirements document covering product capabilities, users, non-goals, and release strategy.

PLAN.md is a non-governing strategic roadmap defining 'complete per the PRD', current milestone position, layer-relation map, roadmap posture and risks, and routes to authorities and the active plans/PLAN_*.md for tranche selection.
DIRECTIVE.md is the Founding directive covering design philosophy, professional boundary, stop rules, and scope constraints.
TYPES.md defines Vocabulary and identity: canonical terms, IDs, statuses, and software/piping domain types.
CONTRACT.md is the Invariant catalog of binding project invariants for legal/data boundary, solver, rule packs, reports, and agents.
SPEC.md is the Technical specification covering architecture, schemas, solver mechanics, GUI, reports, V&V, and agentic execution mechanics.
IP_AND_DATA_BOUNDARY.md is the Data/IP policy covering public/private data rules, contributor certification, provenance, and quarantine policy.
VALIDATION_STRATEGY.md covers Verification and validation: benchmark and release-quality strategy.
AGENTIC_DEVELOPMENT_WORKFLOW.md defines the Agentic workflow: authority surfaces, phase-aware coordination loops, TASK discipline, and handoff expectations.
user_guide/index.md is the User guide: a draft user-facing workflow skeleton, limitations, data boundaries, and current TBDs.
../execution/_Decomposition/SOFTWARE_DECOMP.md is the Working surface holding SSOW, objectives, packages, deliverables, scope ledger summary, telemetry, and open issues.
_Registers/ScopeLedger.csv is an authoritative companion register providing a machine-readable scope-to-package/deliverable mapping.
_Registers/Deliverables.csv is an authoritative companion register providing a machine-readable deliverable catalog.
_Registers/ContextBudgetQA.csv is an authoritative companion register providing a context-envelope and sizing audit.
../governance/MAINTAINERS.md is a Maintainer policy skeleton: a draft public-governance surface for maintainer, contribution, release, and open governance questions.
The current decomposition authority is execution/_Decomposition/SOFTWARE_DECOMP.md revision 0.7, coordinated by approved DAG-006 under execution/_DAG/DAG-006/.
Revision 0.7 carries the accepted architecture runway, design-engine and persistence amendments, and export-format interoperability scope into the active working surface.
The project license selected by human governance decision is PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0; see ../LICENSE.md.

This docs package is a governance and coordination index; it is not an approved engineering work product, not a legal opinion, not a release record, and not a claim of code compliance or professional reliance.
Agents should start from the root INIT.md, then follow execution/_Coordination/_COORDINATION.md for authority intake, work selection, execution discipline, validation, and handoff.
Use execution/_Decomposition/SOFTWARE_DECOMP.md as the authoritative working surface for packages and deliverables.
Use _Registers/*.csv for machine-checkable mappings.
Treat every deliverable as bounded: no agent may expand scope silently.
Unknown values become TBD; suspected protected data is quarantined and escalated.
Generated outputs remain drafts until a human accepts them at the appropriate gate.
Conversation intent for this package is captured in INTENT.md.
Product requirements for this package are captured in PRD.md.
Chirality bootstrap and agent framework examples were supplied by the user as foundational references.
M. W. Kellogg, Design of Piping Systems (1956), is used as a historical technical reference for classical piping flexibility analysis.
